basic_details.offering_entity: Avicenna-Studienwerk e.V. (Funded by Federal Ministry of Education and Research - BMBF)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All State-accredited German Universities and Technical Universities (TU9, Flagship Universities across Germany)
basic_details.major_restrictions: All Academic Disciplines with special emphasis on Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence & Ethics, Engineering, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, and Humanities.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 100 graduate and doctoral scholars accepted annually nationwide
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally to Muslim students and non-Muslim scholars of Islamic studies; typically 5 to 10 Pakistani candidates selected per cycle
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Standard period of study (up to 24 months for Master's, up to 36 months for PhD with 1-year extension possible)

nationality_requirements: German citizens, EU nationals, and international students from all countries including Pakistan with German university admission/enrollment
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory strict age limit, but candidates must be early-career researchers or enrolled graduate students within normative semesters.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree (for Master's track) or 18-year Master's degree (for PhD track) with outstanding academic grades (minimum German GPA 2.0 or CGPA >= 3.40/4.00) from HEC-recognized institutions.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: German scale 1.0-2.0 or minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00; top 15% academic standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate degree matching chosen master's or PhD program in German university.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Either holding unconditional admission offer or currently enrolled in the 1st or 2nd semester of a master's or PhD program at an accredited German institution.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Recent graduation within the past 4 years.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Active volunteerism, community engagement, interfaith dialogue, civic initiatives, or social responsibility strongly emphasized.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: For English-taught programs: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 80+ / MOI certificate accepted. For German-taught programs: CEFR B2/C1 certificate (TestDaF 4x4 or DSH-2). Candidates must be willing to learn German for Foundation network activities.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Willingness to achieve conversational German (B1) for seminar participation.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to women and men; women in STEM strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Muslim students and doctoral candidates of all disciplines, or non-Muslims focusing on Islamic theology/studies, who demonstrate social commitment.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot simultaneously receive funding from another German Begabtenförderungswerk (e.g. DAAD, Konrad Adenauer, Friedrich Ebert).

tuition_fee.details: Public German universities charge zero tuition fees; Avicenna covers full semester contribution fees if eligible.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% Free Tuition at German State Universities

admission_application_fee.details: Avicenna portal application is completely free of charge.

accommodation.details: Scholars access subsidized university student housing (Studierendenwerk dorms EUR 280-420/month) paid via living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Master's: EUR 934/month base allowance + EUR 300/month flat-rate study costs; PhD: EUR 1,400/month base + EUR 100/month research cost allowance.

airfare.details: Initial international flight from Pakistan to Germany is self-funded, but international conference travel grants are available upon application.

visa_fee.details: German national study visa application fee (~EUR 75) paid by applicant at German Embassy Islamabad/Karachi (fee waiver often granted with official BMBF scholarship confirmation letter).

health_insurance.details: Health and long-term care insurance subsidy up to EUR 120 / month provided directly.
health_insurance.amount: Up to EUR 120 / month direct health subsidy

food_allowance.details: Subsidized university dining hall (Mensa) access across German campus locations.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: EUR 300 / month flat-rate study materials allowance for master's; EUR 100 / month for PhD candidates.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Doctoral scholars receive research allowances and special travel funds for field research abroad.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to EUR 1,500 / year project research funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Semester ticket (Deutschlandticket integration) providing free public regional rail and urban transit across Germany.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Free regional & urban transit via semester ticket

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple host institutions (any recognized public university or technical university in Germany).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: All top-tier German universities; renowned across AI, computer science, mechanical engineering, life sciences, and social sciences.
available_majors: MSc / PhD in Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
MSc / PhD in Software Systems Engineering
MSc / PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering
MSc / PhD in Biomedical Sciences & Biotechnology
MSc / PhD in Public Policy, Economics & Management
MSc / PhD in Philosophy, Ethics & Islamic Studies
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 2 years; PhD: 3 years (extensible to 4 years)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's (CGPA >= 3.40/4.00) or 18-year Master's degree, proof of admission/enrollment at a German university (or doctoral supervision confirmation), CV, two academic references, one civic engagement reference, and interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing university admission or supervisor agreement is required first; TU Munich and RWTH Aachen have highly competitive direct admissions.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Highlight interdisciplinary relevance and societal commitment; connect technical focus with ethical implications and civic values.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Avicenna application portal during active intake window, upload personal statement, academic transcripts, German enrollment/admission certificate, and register two academic referees and one civic referee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Secure admission to or enrollment at an accredited German university for master's or obtain doctoral supervision confirmation (Betreuungszusage).
Step 2: Prepare German-standard CV (Europass format), motivation letter reflecting academic goals and civic engagement, and academic transcripts.
Step 3: Register two academic referees and one civic/social engagement referee on the portal.
Step 4: Submit online application via Avicenna application portal between December 1 and February 1 (or June 1 to August 1 for summer intake).
Step 5: Undergo independent academic dossier evaluation by university professors and foundation experts.
Step 6: Shortlisted candidates attend in-person or virtual selection interviews in Germany (panel interview evaluating academic competence, personality, and values).
Step 7: Receive formal scholarship award decision from the independent selection committee in July/August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Separate Routing: Candidates must first secure admission/supervision at an accredited German university, then apply independently to Avicenna-Studienwerk for fellowship funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two university professors and one civic/community leadership referee.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Detailed personal statement outlining academic goals, scholarly curiosity, and demonstrated commitment to community, civic engagement, or interfaith dialogue.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must submit a 5 to 10-page research proposal detailing objectives, state of research, methodology, and work plan.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Tabular academic CV in Europass format detailing education, awards, publications, and volunteer/civic work.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Comprehensive selection interview weekend comprising individual interview and panel discussion assessing intellectual maturity and social commitment.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 80+ for English programs; CEFR B2/C1 for German-taught degrees.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA attested degrees and transcripts from Pakistan.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or German translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via Avicenna application portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed 2 to 3-page statement explaining academic ambitions, personal trajectory, and commitment to civic/social engagement.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly highlight leadership initiatives and community service in Pakistan or internationally.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Tabular CV in Europass format detailing academic history, publications, honors, and civic volunteering.
Proof of university admission or current enrollment at a German university (or doctoral supervisor letter).
Certified copies of Bachelor's/Master's degrees and semester-by-semester grade sheets with minimum CGPA 3.40 / 4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential recommendation letters from university professors assessing academic excellence and research potential.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official university letterhead with institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Reference letter from an NGO, civil society organization, or volunteer initiative confirming applicant's civic contributions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed letter from community organization or student society.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 5 to 10-page PhD research proposal including literature review, methodology, and timeline.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include preliminary bibliography and research methodology.

important_dates_timeline.university_admission_deadline: Concurrent with or prior to Avicenna application
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Avicenna conducts two application rounds per year (deadlines February 1 for winter semester and August 1 for summer semester).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Academic transcript excellence, degree honors, and intellectual capability)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Demonstrated civic engagement, volunteer initiatives, and alignment with foundation values)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Quality of study plan, research orientation, or PhD project feasibility)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 5% (Clarity of motivation essay and personal trajectory)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Personal maturity, articulation, critical thinking, and social awareness in interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Independent selection committee comprising German university professors, Islamic scholars, and civil society representatives.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: formal and academic dossier review followed by selection interview weekend.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,200 applicants nationwide across both cycles
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12% to 18% for shortlisted applicants with strong GPAs and active community engagement
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars in STEM, medicine, social sciences, or law with top-tier grades and documented civic responsibility.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, LUMS, FAST, Quaid-i-Azam University, UET, and Aga Khan University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Germany, Pakistan, Turkey, Syria, Egypt, Bosnia, Iran, Morocco.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of third-party agencies claiming to sell foundation sponsorships or guarantee admissions.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Avicenna-Studienwerk never charges any fee for applying or processing applications.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: No recruitment agents or consultancies are authorized. Direct individual application is strictly mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: German National Visa fee: €75 (~PKR 23,000) (often waived with official BMBF scholarship confirmation).
HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 to 25,000.
Initial living deposit before first stipend disbursement: ~€500 (~PKR 150,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: The fellowship is only for Islamic theological studies. Reality: The majority of fellows study STEM, medicine, and engineering at German universities.
Myth: Non-German speakers cannot apply. Reality: English-medium master's and doctoral scholars are fully eligible with willingness to learn German.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs state that German fluency is mandatory at application; official guidelines confirm that English-speaking international students enrolled in English programs are fully eligible.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum 2.0 German grade average and satisfactory progress in research/coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Active participation in the Foundation's ideational support program, including at least two mandatory foundation academies/seminars per year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports and grade transcripts submitted to foundation advisors.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time academic work (up to 10 hours/week) permitted with foundation approval; commercial full-time employment prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation (scholars may utilize Germany's 18-month jobseeker visa or work globally).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of fellowship in case of falsified documentation, severe academic misconduct, or abandonment of study without valid cause.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing universities within Germany is permitted upon timely notification and approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Subject change allowed within the first two semesters subject to Foundation committee review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Standard tenure is 24 months for Master's and 36 months for PhD; up to 12 months extension possible for doctoral completion upon application.
